scheme_name: Bharati Scheme for Education - Intermediate or Equivalent
other_conditions: Student must belong to the Brahmin community
Student must be studying in Andhra Pradesh
Parents/guardians must reside in Andhra Pradesh
Student must be enrolled in a recognized and reputed college for the academic year in Andhra Pradesh
Student must have cleared all subjects of the previous year
Student must be enrolled in the Praja Sadhikara Survey (PSS)
Student must not have availed any amount under any other government scheme for the same purpose, except those receiving benefit from Archaka Welfare Trust
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹10,000 per student for Intermediate or equivalent courses.
